uses.text: Entertainment or event facility, indoor or outdoor (a commercial entertainment or event use for cultural, recreational, artistic, athletic or social events; it does not include adult entertainment, casinos, nightclubs or private event venues)

notes: Development plans must follow the permitted uses and standards (Exhibit B) and the concept plan (Exhibit C).
Final planned development site plan approval is required before a permit for site infrastructure.
The number of parking spaces, shared parking and the retail parking in the parking structures depend on the agreements between the Town and the developer.
Rooftop mechanical equipment must be screened from view from all rights-of-way.
Solid waste and recycling should be shared where feasible, and dumpsters and compactors may not stand free on the site.
